title: 第23章 新县令
content_zh:
魏乐府动用了不少关系，也确定了李崇昭的情况。

    如果说不是所有人都一起说谎的话，那这李崇昭确实头铁。

    哪怕只是立人设，但对方真要是一辈子不变，那魏乐府也认为是真的。

    仔细想想，魏乐府也明白了太子的用意。

    大宣皇帝人到中年，差不多也到了该考虑后事的年纪了。

    灵气复苏虽然让小部分人成为炼气士，但炼气士能不能延寿那都是两说呢。

    压根就没人能验证，所以按照平均寿命，大宣皇帝其实算是活得久了。

    而魏乐府产出的各种带有灵气的农副产品，对于太子来说也是具有极大价值。

    所以最好是要掌握在手里，所以要提前布局才行。

    免得日后大宣皇帝驾崩，他手忙脚乱。

    所以魏乐府估计，这李崇昭过来，第一件事就是要削了自己的清浦县男的爵位。

    当初的大宣皇帝为了招揽炼气士，分封出去太多爵位了。

    太子不一定镇得住，大宣皇帝也知道这件事，所以才睁一只眼闭一只眼甚至暗地里配合。

    但那是之前呀，现在的大宣皇帝成了世界代行者，都穿梭世界了，野心肯定是进一步提升。

    那么接下来有两种可能。

    一种是彻底放权，甚至是禅位成为太上皇，然后把控关键权力同时重心转移。

    第二种是不放权，两手抓。

    以大宣皇帝的果决，魏乐府估计是第一种。

    这个大宣王朝的格局和运行逻辑其实正在改变，因为降临任务奖励的天地奇物、天材地宝甚至道种点，都在推动王朝朝着追求力量的方向不断狂奔。

    所以接下来的演变，可能就是强者为尊和拳即是权。

    只不过进度比较慢而已，毕竟才只是进行了一次降临任务，再加上灵气复苏程度受限和世界代行者人数也少。

    魏乐府揉了揉太阳穴，开口问道：“老袁，那位新县太爷到哪里了？”

    “回禀老爷，还有半个时辰应该就能入城了。”袁敬亭立刻回答，而后又问道：“老爷，不过是一位七品芝麻官，您何必去亲自迎接呢。”

    魏乐府听到这话，也没好气地说道：“你家老爷我也才六品而已。”

    “别拿豆包不当干粮，县令可是号称百里侯呢。”

    “可老爷，您可是真正的爵爷。”袁敬亭觉得太给对方脸了，正常应该是对方上门来拜访才对。
content_en:
Wei Yuefu used many connections to determine Li Chongzhao's situation.

If not everyone is lying together, then Li Chongzhao is really stubborn.

Even if it's just a persona, if the other person really doesn't change for the rest of his life, then Wei Yuefu will think it's true.

After thinking about it carefully, Wei Yuefu also understood the prince's intention.

Emperor Daxuan reached middle age and was almost at the age where he should consider his future affairs.

Although the recovery of spiritual energy has allowed a small number of people to become Qi practitioners, there is no telling whether Qi practitioners can extend their lives.

No one can verify it at all, so according to the average life span, Emperor Daxuan actually lived a long time.

The various agricultural and sideline products with spiritual energy produced by Wei Yuefu are also of great value to the prince.

Therefore, it is best to have it in hand, so plan it in advance.

To avoid being in a hurry when Emperor Daxuan dies in the future.

Therefore, Wei Yuefu estimated that when Li Chongzhao came over, the first thing he did was to deprive himself of his Qingpu County male title.

In order to recruit Qi practitioners, the original Emperor Daxuan gave out too many titles.

The prince may not be able to control it, and Emperor Daxuan also knew about it, so he turned a blind eye or even cooperated secretly.

But that was before. Now Emperor Daxuan has become the world's agent and has traveled around the world. His ambitions must have been further enhanced.

Then there are two possibilities.

One is to completely delegate power, or even become the Supreme Emperor, and then control key powers while shifting the focus.

The second is not to delegate power but to grasp it with both hands.

Judging from the decisiveness of Emperor Daxuan, Wei Yuefu is probably the first.

The structure and operating logic of the Daxuan Dynasty are actually changing, because the rare objects, materials, treasures and even Taoist points rewarded by advent missions are pushing the dynasty towards the pursuit of power.

Therefore, the next evolution may be that the strong is respected and boxing is the right.

It's just that the progress is relatively slow. After all, it is only an advent mission. In addition, the recovery of spiritual energy is limited and the number of world agents is also small.

Wei Yuefu rubbed his temples and asked, "Old Yuan, where is the new county magistrate?"

"Replying to the master, we should be able to enter the city in half an hour." Yuan Jingting replied immediately, and then asked: "Sir, I am just a seventh-grade sesame official, why do you have to go and greet me personally."

When Wei Yuefu heard this, he said angrily: "Your master, I am only in the sixth rank."

"Don't use bean bags as dry food. The county magistrate is known as Bailihou."

"But sir, you are the real lord." Yuan Jingting felt that it was too shameful for the other party. Normally, the other party should come to visit.
